map.Fagerström尼古丁依赖检验量表（FTND），6题评估尼古丁依赖程度，指导: Fagerstrom Test for Nicotine Dependence (FTND): 6 items assess the level of nicotine dependence and guide quit-smoking planning
map.：FTND 5 分→中度依赖，建议药物(伐尼克兰/贴剂)+行为支持。: An FTND score of 5 means moderate dependence; medication (varenicline or patches) plus behavioural support is recommended.
map.：≥7 分重度，单靠意志力难戒，需强化药物与随访。: A score of 7 or more means severe dependence; willpower alone is not enough to quit, and stronger medication plus follow-up is required.

map.评分用途？: What is the score used for?
map.依赖越高越需药物辅助与高频随访。: The higher the dependence, the more medication support and frequent follow-up are needed.
